youtube_title: Same Bro Games #19: Which Car Is Faster? 3 Levels of Logic #Shorts
youtube_description:
SAME BRO GAMES #19. Three speed puzzles. Level 1: 120 km in 2 hours vs 90 km in 1 hour. Level 2: 100 m in 5 seconds vs 1 km in 1 minute. Final level: a 120 km trip, A drives 60 km/h all the way, B drives half at 120 and half at 40. Who arrives first? Comment your answers.
Answers: B (60 vs 90 km/h), A (72 vs 60 km/h), and a TIE: both take exactly 2 hours. Average speed is not the average of the two speeds.
